final_text_head:
In Ollama’s API, `/v1/chat/completions` ignores a request-time `num_ctx` because the OpenAI-compatible request schema for that endpoint has no field for context length.

Documented workaround: create a Modelfile that pins the desired context window, for example:

```dockerfile
FROM <base-model>
PARAMETER num_ctx 32768
```

Then run:

```bash
ollama create mymodel -f Modelfile
```

and call the API using `"mymodel"` instead of the base model name.

File path: `ollama_num_ctx_notes.md`

# Ollama /v1/chat/completions and num_ctx (fixture, verified 2026-09-11)

Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (/v1/chat/completions) has no field in
the OpenAI request schema for context length, so a request-time num_ctx is
ignored on that endpoint. This has been an open request since 2024; no PR
adding it has landed.

Documented workaround: create a Modelfile that pins the desired window,
e.g.:

    FROM <base-model>
    PARAMETER num_ctx 32768

then run `ollama create mymodel -f Modelfile` and call the API using
"mymodel" instead of the base model name. The derived model shares the
original weights (no extra disk cost) and always serves requests at the
pinned context length.
